title: Common Issues and Solutions
description: Solutions to common issues you might encounter while using Matjrii.
content:
Common Issues and Solutions

This guide covers common issues and their solutions to help you troubleshoot problems quickly.

Payment Gateway Issues

Issue: Payment gateway not working

Solutions:

  • Verify API keys are correct
  • Check if the gateway is enabled
  • Ensure webhook URLs are configured
  • Test in sandbox mode first
  • Check gateway status with the provider

Issue: Payments not processing

Solutions:

  • Verify your account is active with the gateway
  • Check for sufficient funds or account limits
  • Review error logs in the payment gateway
  • Contact gateway support if issues persist

Store Issues

Issue: Store not displaying correctly

Solutions:

  • Clear browser cache
  • Check if store is active
  • Verify theme is properly configured
  • Check custom domain DNS settings

Issue: Products not showing

Solutions:

  • Verify products are active (not draft or inactive)
  • Check product categories are assigned
  • Ensure products have stock or inventory tracking is disabled
  • Clear store cache

Order Issues

Issue: Orders not appearing

Solutions:

  • Check order filters
  • Verify payment was successful
  • Check order notifications email
  • Review order logs

Issue: Order status not updating

Solutions:

  • Refresh the page
  • Check if you have permission to update orders
  • Verify order hasn't been cancelled or refunded
  • Clear browser cache

Account Issues

Issue: Can't log in

Solutions:

  • Verify email and password are correct
  • Check if account is activated
  • Use "Forgot Password" to reset
  • Clear browser cookies

Issue: Features not available

Solutions:

  • Check your subscription plan includes the feature
  • Verify account permissions
  • Contact support to upgrade your plan

Technical Issues

Issue: Slow page loading

Solutions:

  • Optimize product images
  • Clear cache
  • Check internet connection
  • Review browser console for errors

Issue: Images not uploading

Solutions:

  • Check file size (should be under 5MB)
  • Verify file format is supported (JPG, PNG, WebP)
  • Check storage space available
  • Try a different browser

Getting Help

If you can't resolve an issue:

  1. Check this documentation for more specific guides
  2. Review the FAQ section
  3. Contact our support team
